email.subject: Salt Flat Group Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I checked Salt Flat Group Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "auto repair Harbor Falls" can't tap to call and probably just call the next shop instead. And there's no booking option, so anyone ready to schedule has to call during business hours or give up.

The site also has no reviews shown, no listed hours, and a weak page title that undersells what you do.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no obligation.

Alex
